findings.description: Action Scheduler pinned to ~4.1.0, so security releases in 4.2+ are not picked up automatically. 4.1.x patch releases are.
findings.recommendation: Revisit the pin when FSS moves to WordPress 6.9 or later.

instrument_validation.library: See stop-user-enumeration .sdlc/PLUGINS_SMALL-6/security-scan.json: sanitisation sweep validated against 958c57d^; guard-before-state-change sweep UNVALIDATED (no prior fix of that class), reviewed manually

notes: The FSS change adds one library call in the uninstall routine, which runs only from WordPress's uninstall flow, plus dependency constraints. No new input handling. The library changes are as scanned for SUE 1.7.10, plus the 1.3.3 manage_options check on skip.
